assets.name: water_streaks
assets.prompt: Several uneven dark brown mineral water streaks running vertically down a wall from a leaking ceiling. Concentrated broad dirty tide mark near the top with long fine branching drips below, a few green-grey mould freckles, translucent edges, residue with varying opacity. Leave all image margins transparent. Not paint splashes.

assets.name: rising_damp
assets.prompt: A horizontally continuous bottom-wall rising-damp and black/olive-grey mould band. Dark denser soiled residue along the lower fifth, irregular fading porous tide line and very fine rising damp trails up to halfway. Seamless left-to-right tiling strip: perfectly matching content at left and right edges, no side fade; transparent top and sparse transparent lower edge. No actual wall.

assets.name: ceiling_rings
assets.prompt: One irregular overlapping cluster of tan and brown ceiling leak water stain rings, nested broad pale ochre diffuse moisture halos, thin ragged dark tide edges, tiny black mould freckles. Delicate semitransparent residue, naturally asymmetric, flat scan without any ceiling tile or background. Transparent margins.

assets.name: carpet_stains
assets.prompt: One old dark sticky soda spill and dirty damp carpet stain. Irregular amorphous desaturated dark brown/purple discoloration with fibrous feathered edges and a few scattered smaller splash droplets. Very translucent patch of staining only, no carpet substrate and no shadows, transparent surrounding pixels.

assets.name: puddle_outline
assets.prompt: A dark water-soaked carpet perimeter ring around an irregular leaked-water puddle. Organic low rounded asymmetric outline, large transparent centre, dark translucent charcoal-purple saturated wet fibre residue along an uneven broad softly feathered edge. Fine damp wicking fringes. No water interior, no floor or reflections, transparent background.

assets.name: peeling_wallpaper
assets.prompt: One torn and curling wallpaper sheet, old near-black charcoal acoustic-textured vinyl wallcovering face, cracked faded black surface, a curled lower corner shows its dirty brown kraft-paper backing. A few ragged tiny chips and split seam, alpha around irregular perimeter. Front view, restrained relief, no wall or anything behind. Real dark fibrous wallcovering, not floral wallpaper.

assets.name: cobweb
assets.prompt: One dusty abandoned cobweb that spans a right-angle ceiling wall corner. Delicate uneven sparse silk radial threads and sagging looping cross threads making a triangular fan from top-left corner to lower-right. Whisper-thin light grey / beige threads with a few dusty nodes. Genuinely transparent between individual threads, no dark background, no thick rope, no spider.

assets.name: soot_plume
assets.prompt: A single smoke soot/grime stain rising above a wall lamp: narrow dense charcoal bottom at centre, expanding gently into a tall irregular diffuse plume towards the top, finely speckled carbon dust and faded soft grey fringe. Semitransparent soot residue only, no lamp, no wall, no solid shape, very diffuse edges.

assets.name: popcorn_cups
assets.prompt: Top-down orthographic photographic scan of a small abandoned cinema rubbish spill: scattered small offwhite butter-yellow popcorn kernels, two crumpled plain faded burgundy striped paper soda cups on their sides, one lid, a bent plain straw and two little ticket stubs without readable writing. Lots of clear transparent gaps between pieces. Compact loose cluster, physical object colours, no surface or shadows.

assets.name: carpet_wear
assets.prompt: A seamless vertical worn-carpet foot traffic strip overlay. Fine compressed deep-purple / faded plum pile fibres in a broad central lighter worn lane, subtly darker dirty feathered sides fading fully into transparency at left and right. Only thin translucent fibre discoloration and abrasion, not a solid carpet rectangle. Seamless top-to-bottom repeat with matching ends. Designed over magenta/cyan synthwave patterned cinema carpet; no neon pattern baked in, no scene.

common_prompt: Production alpha decal albedo for abandoned 1980s-90s multiplex / Backrooms. Square 1024 request, actual transparent background, flat orthographic scan, neutral diffuse light, no scene, shadows, watermark, border, text or substrate. Photographic microdetail. Preserve irregular cutout and feathered alpha; continuous matching repeat edges for rising damp and carpet wear.
source_policy: Generated source PNGs copied byte-for-byte; 1254 square RGBA originals retained. Production outputs are resampled to1024 in premultiplied space and saved with straight alpha.
processing: make_pbr.make_pbr size1024 strength3 (peeling6), rough_base0.88 (carpet_stains/puddle_outline0.65), rough_var0.08, OpenGL. Preserve RGBA albedo after make_pbr RGB output. Mask normal back to128,128,255 using alpha; damp/wear outermost normal and rough edges matched. Luminance attenuates pale residue alpha; soot RGB*=0.16, carpet stain RGB*=0.48, puddle ring RGB*=0.44, wear alpha*=0.24, web alpha highlight attenuation. Final visual pass water RGB*=0.24/alpha*=0.72, damp RGB*=0.27/alpha*=0.68, ceiling ring RGB*=0.65/alpha*=0.70.
derived_reverse: Additional peeling_wallpaper_back set uses identical alpha to front, kraft RGB(104,99,81) with subtle luminance fibre variation; normal/rough copied from front. This matches both-side export metadata to visible rendered colour.
